body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> JayBird presented its Blutooth headphone 'Sportsband' during showstoppers at CES 2010, which is easy to use controls and rubberized underside band for grip during exercise. It includes microphone for phone calls.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
